scripts.text:
[Amachang]
Welcome to Amatsu,
the town of kind towners
and beautiful cherry blossoms.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
欢迎来到樱花城，
这里有热情的镇民
和美丽的樱花。

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
I'm Amachang,
the 13th Miss Amatsu.
I will guide you about town
as Miss Amatsu.
Please tell me
if you want to know something.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
我是阿玛畅，
第13代樱花城小姐。
我会作为樱花城小姐
为您介绍这座城镇。
如果您想了解什么，
请告诉我。

scripts.text: Palace
scripts.translation: 宫殿

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 工具店

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Bar
scripts.translation: 酒吧

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
On the mini-map,
go to ^FF3355+^000000
to find the Palace.
Have a good time
in Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
在小地图上，
前往 ^FF3355+^000000
即可找到宫殿。
祝您在樱花城
玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guide Man]
Welcome, tourist from Midgard.
I'm the guide of
our beautiful town, Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
欢迎来自米德加尔特
的游客。
我是这座美丽城镇
樱花城的向导。

scripts.text:
[Guide Man]
What are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
您在找什么？
